verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents event-triggered flows: merchants set up flows based on Klaviyo events, and automations are available even on the free plan. Events can be ingested via API and SDKs to drive those triggers, and AI tooling can create flows. A community user confirms you can tag site events and act on them, such as a 'haven't seen you in a while' email. Missing for 10: detailed docs on rule/trigger configuration (conditions, filters, branching), explicit evidence that flows can be defined programmatically via API/MCP rather than only in the UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of flow-building depth.
